item.title: Madang commemorates World TB Day and National Council of Women Day
item.description: Madang marked World Tuberculosis Day on March 24, 2026, under the theme “Yes! We Can End TB in PNG,” alongside celebrations of National Council of Women Day.

item.title: Alluvial Gold Mining sustains livelihoods along the Ok Tedi River
item.description: Alluvial mining along the Ok Tedi River remains a key source of income for communities in the North Fly District, with people of all ages relying on the activity to support their daily needs.

item.title: New law and justice partnership empowers Bougainville students
item.description: Bougainville’s students will gain new opportunities to learn about respect, safety, and justice through a pioneering partnership between schools and the law and justice sector. The program will help young people understand their rights and responsibilities, encourage positive behavior, and create safer schools, and an investment in Bougainville’s future.

item.title: Successful academy program relaunches under PNGRFL
item.description: The Papua New Guinea Rugby Football League (PNGRFL) is delighted to relaunch the highly successful PNG NRL Academy as the PNGRFL Academy, with the program coming under the management and oversight of the national governing body.

item.title: PM Marape orders full report on PNGDF recruitment, assures transparency ahead of 2027 elections
item.description: Prime Minister James Marape has directed an urgent and comprehensive report into recent Papua New Guinea Defence Force (PNGDF) recruitment concerns, assuring the nation that transparency, accountability, and national interest will guide all actions taken.

item.title: Madang United confident as 30-man squad named for 2026 PSL season
item.description: Madang United Football Club has expressed confidence in its squad following the announcement of a 30-man train-on team ahead of the 2026 Premier Soccer League (PSL) season.

item.title: Nasfund ends successful CEO’s Business Breakfast and Employer Conference
item.description: Nasfund today ended a successful CEO’s Business Breakfast and Employer Conference, where Chairman Christopher Elphick spoke to business leaders on the high-level impact of superannuation on everyday Papua New Guineans, stressing that superannuation is not simply a statutory requirement but a cornerstone of long-term financial security and dignity.

item.title: Rumginae School of Nursing to celebrate first-ever diploma graduation
item.description: The Rumginae School of Nursing (RSON) in North Fly District, Western Province, will host its first-ever Diploma in General Nursing graduation tomorrow, Thursday, March 26, 2026.

item.title: Indigenous landowners issue clarion call to halt Panguna activities, demand inclusion
item.description: A powerful coalition of indigenous resource owners has issued an urgent call for the immediate halt of all activities concerning the Panguna mine, demanding that the Autonomous Bougainville Government (ABG), Bougainville Copper Limited (BCL), and its preferred partner, Lloyds Metals and Energy Ltd, respect their legally guaranteed rights.

item.title: PM Marape tables Prime Minister Amendment Bill to overhaul public service performance
item.description: Prime Minister James Marape tabled the Prime Minister (Amendment) Bill 2026 in Parliament, describing it as a decisive Reform aimed at strengthening accountability and improving efficiency, across Papua New Guinea’s Public Service.

item.title: Evictions making more families homeless
item.description: The Government of Papua New Guinea continues to fail the people of this nation by not ensuring that proper eviction processes and procedures are complied with in conducting evictions in the country.

item.title: Joint NEC submission for Forestry SEZ
item.description: The Minister for Forest Hon. Salio Waipo and the Minister for International Trade and Investment Hon. Richard Maru, today, jointly signed seven submissions to go before the National Executive Council (NEC).

item.title: Competent managers for public service
item.description: In recent weeks this newspaper has been running stories about financial institutions and super funds making heaps of profits for their shareholders and members across the country.
